title: Diagnose control source-recovery server shutdown timeout after stdin EOF
outcome: Correct the proven fixture shutdown bookkeeping and first-error defects, preserve the unchanged shutdown bound, and capture lifecycle evidence for any recurring control shutdown timeout.
acceptance: control-dogfood's teardown can no longer manufacture or mask a shutdown timeout (legacy versus corrected proven by the deterministic discriminator); the source-recovery test exits within its unchanged bound; any future occurrence records the lifecycle evidence that names its cause.

completion.summary: Corrected fixture shutdown bookkeeping and first-error preservation, kept the 5000 ms shutdown bound, and added lifecycle evidence plus deterministic regressions. Landed and installed the exact gated tree; historical control-server hang cause remains unproven and the independent recurrence watch remains open.
